## Professional Career

- **2026** - Research assistant, full time 
  DATALAB, Aarhus University, Aarhus, Denmark. Development of report for the Danish Ministiry of Digital Affairs

- **2023-present** - PhD Student, full-time  
  DATALAB, Aarhus University, Aarhus, Denmark. 

- **2025** - Fellowship
  Digital News Dynamics Group, Weizenbaum Institute, Berlin, Germany.

- **2023** - Assistant Lecturer, part-time
  University of Copenhagen, Denmark.

- **2022-2023** - Research Assistant, full-time  
  HCDS Group, IT University, Copenhagen, Denmark. Focus: online videos and data visualization.

- **2016-2019** - Video Producer, full-time  
  Label Software Gerald Bax GmbH, Bielefeld, Germany. Focus: media relations and tutorial production.

## Education

- **2019-2022** - Master of Arts, Cognition and Communication  
  University of Copenhagen, Denmark. Thesis: *Experimental- and survey-research on online videos: The credibility effects of production value and cognitive processing fluency*.

- **2012-2019** - Bachelor of Science, Biology major and Linguistics minor  
  University of Bielefeld, Germany.

## Teaching Experience

- **2024-2025** - Lecturer: Research Design and Methods: Casestudies
  Aarhus University, Denmark. Part of teaching team for Master-level digital methods courses

- **2023** - Lecturer Communication Theory and Research Design
  University of Copenhagen, Denmark. Part of teaching team for Master-level course

- **2023-2025** - Special Paedagogical Support, voluntary activity  
  IT University, Copenhagen, Denmark. Advising students with special needs.

- **2020** - Tutor, voluntary activity  
  University of Copenhagen, Copenhagen, Denmark. Guidance the new year of Cognition and Communication students.

## Grants and Contracts

- **2026** - Awarded contract, independent study  
  Ministry of Digital Affairs, Denmark: *Tech Giants' Influence on Democracy, Well-Being, and Social Cohesion in Denmark*. Responsible for DATALAB's contribution as part of the consortium selected to deliver the Ministry-commissioned independent report for 2026.

- **2025** -  Travel grants
  William Demant Fonden: Awarded funding to support international research mobility during the PhD, including a study exchange at the Weizenbaum Institute in Berlin and conference participation at CompText 2026 in Birmingham.

- **2022** - Foundational Integrity Grant  
  Meta Platforms Inc.: *Investigating Persuasiveness of Contextualized Disinformation Across Media*. Spearheaded the conceptualization and development of the research proposal on behalf of the HCDS Group at IT University, Copenhagen.
